description_en: Queries the information about a task
description_zh: 调用DescribeTaskInfo接口查看相关管控任务流进度
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-task-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-bp1xxxxxxxx47 --task-id 225685759 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTaskInfo

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

FinishTime.description_en: The end time of the task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

Progress.description_en: The progress of the task. Unit: %

Status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:

Waiting
Running
Finished
Failed
Closed
Cancel
Retry
Pause
Stop
Status.description_zh:
状态：

Waiting：等待中
Running：执行中
Finished：已结束
Failed：失败
Closed：已关闭
Cancel：已取消
Retry：重试
Pause：暂停
Stop：中断
